mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagnosis_task ( title, device_name, status, risk_level, vibration_document_id, speed_document_id, parameter_template_id, parameter_kb_id, summary, metadata, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{deviceName}, #{status}, #{riskLevel}, CAST(#{vibrationDocumentId} AS uuid), CAST(#{speedDocumentId} AS uuid), CAST(#{parameterTemplateId} AS uuid), CAST(#{parameterKbId} AS uuid), #{summary}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, device_name, status, risk_level, vibration_document_id, speed_document_id, parameter_template_id, parameter_kb_id, summary, metadata::text AS metadata, created_at, updated_at FROM diagnosis_task WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)

SELECT id, title, device_name, status, risk_level, vibration_document_id, speed_document_id, parameter_template_id, parameter_kb_id, summary, metadata::text AS metadata, created_at, updated_at FROM diagnosis_task ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE diagnosis_task
title = #{title},
device_name = #{deviceName},
status = #{status},
risk_level = #{riskLevel},
vibration_document_id = CAST(#{vibrationDocumentId} AS uuid),
speed_document_id = CAST(#{speedDocumentId} AS uuid),
parameter_template_id = CAST(#{parameterTemplateId} AS uuid),
parameter_kb_id = CAST(#{parameterKbId} AS uuid),
summary = #{summary},
metadata = CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb),
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
